prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine the supplied Qing Jiangnan Buddhist temple hall sprite in image2 to an EXACT 2:1 orthographic dimetric ground plane shown in image1. Keep architecture/material style: grand detailed weathered gray clay tiled roof with restrained ridge ornaments and upward eave tips, dark red timber columns, dark carved lattice doors, off-white plaster side walls, gray stone low base, limited teal/ochre painted beams, small bronze censer at front. Same muted realistic ancient Chinese map sprite quality. Current temple sprite has the right materials but the camera is slightly TOO STEEP; lower its elevation a little, floor axes exactly +0.500 and -0.500, no vanishing point. The temple's floor needs slightly more depth for true14:11 width/depth. Mandatory ground perimeter from image1 on1536x1024 canvas: LEFT=(168,594), FRONT=(840,930), RIGHT=(1368,666), BACK=(696,330). Keep these corners and silhouette of thin floor slab precisely. Place main hall within this pad, front faces lower-left; narrow real gray flagstone border and stairs only INSIDE pad. Do not reinterpret guide footprint. All roof ridges, beams, sills, wall feet parallel with relevant guide axes. Remove guide drawing lines, render fine realistic irregular stone textures. True transparent RGBA outside asset. Main illumination upper-left short tiny shadow lower-right. Full roof/finials safely uncropped, empty transparent margins. No people, writing, symbols, signs, modern objects, watermark or large background shadow. No thick diorama pedestal.
